race.comment: BARRETT REEF (1) has the most appealing set-up after leading and finishing fifth in a BM56 over 1590m at this track last week, where he beat SACRED INGOT home and was not disgraced despite being unwanted in the market. The drop to BM52 and return to 1400m, a distance at which he has already won, give him the right profile to improve. SACRED INGOT (5) is the clear danger from the same race; he settled well back, charged home into sixth and now comes back to a distance where his record is sound. CUMBRIAN QUEEN (8) brings a different form line after a solid Wodonga second and has a strong 1400m place record, while the winning rider returning adds to her appeal. AMERICAN RUSS (2) has placed at both runs this campaign, including a wide third at Manangatang, and looks a genuine minor-money hope if he holds that level third-up.
